final_payload.rationale_summary: Retrieved the four required US_TREASURY_5Y_CMT observations, computed the three interval growth rates, averaged the first two interval growth rates, and compared the third interval growth against that mean. The third interval growth exceeded the mean, so the higher reference is assigned to the as of 1972-03-09–as of 1972-03-10 interval.
